name: appsec
description: 2 security scanning skills: appsec-scan (container-based CI-mirror running Fortify SAST, Parasoft, Pylint, ESLint, Scantist SCA, Trivy, and GitLab Secret Detection — same images as your GitLab pipeline) and appsec-dast-sim (LLM-based DAST following OWASP WSTG v4.2 — no running app required).
